notes.title: CODE PANDORA 2
notes.content:
[h2]CODE: PANDORA 2 — out today[/h2][p]No fanfare, no big words: we’ve released [b]CODE: PANDORA 2[/b]—a world of futurism and eroticism, the direct continuation of [b]Driply[/b]’s adventures.
(A deep bow to [b]Robert Sheckley[/b]—he truly inspired us.ːsteamhappyː)[/p][p]This game was born from unreleased DLC ideas for the first title; we accumulated so much material it became a full standalone story.[/p][h3]Quick +18 guide[/h3][p]The erotic ending [b]“Matrix of the Absolute Weapon”[/b] is easy to get: talk to everyone and keep a friendly, positive route. This path is for those who want to enjoy the cut-scenes without diving deep into the mechanics.[/p][p][b]Feature: X-Zetrix.[/b] If you assemble [b]X-Zetrix[/b] even once and unlock just [b]one[/b] scene, the Gallery will immediately open [b]all[/b] scenes with her (except her ending).[/p][h3]Light spoilers[/h3][list][*][p][b]X-Zetrix modules:[/b] look for them on the planets of [b]Emperor Nox[/b], [b]Overlord Whisperer[/b], [b]Lady Iris[/b], and [b]Rascal Z[/b]—available [b]without[/b] Acts of Terror.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zone 69 artifacts:[/b][/p][list][*][p]at [b]Glok[/b]—during an [b]Act of Terror[/b]; descend to the [b]lowest floor[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]at [b]Rascal Z[/b]—simply land and chat with the right people;[/p][/*][*][p]another one is right on the [b]Ghost-5[/b] station;[/p][/*][*][p]and one near [b]Corsair Seraph[/b]—[b]not far from his gauntlet[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Landings[/h3][p]You can land [b]without negative consequences[/b] on the worlds of [b]Nox[/b], [b]Rascal Z[/b], and [b]Lady Iris[/b].[/p][p]See you in Pandora. 18+
